text:
If the plant arrived damaged (snapped main stem, cracked or smashed pot, exposed roots, or dead or severely wilted), report it within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the plant and the box. You'll get a free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or a refund.

After 48 hours, it goes through the Plant Care Guarantee instead. You have **30 days** from delivery (**90 days** for Leafy Plus members) to claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within **2 business days**.
